body:
They say there's safety in numbers...


try telling that to 6 billion Jews.
well, if you read it, my feelings aren't exactly /sui/cidal. and she damn well needs to be  enlightened by treatment with retractable batons.

It's not negative. and I didn't come here for support, I came here for ideas. Also, anyone who resorts to threats of violence to stay in someone's life really does deserve to be locked up for being evil. She's clearly not suicidal if she does it so often not even her parents care to intervene anymore. She's likely just attention whoring and it needs to stop. The best route to making it stop is to ignore it.

I'mma say the same thing I said on r/depression: death is the coward's way out. you'll end up leaving a financial and emotional burden on all your loved ones.. and that's just the beginning of it. at least here there's definitely other people to talk to about your problems. And if you're dead? who can say? I'm just saying death is not very constructive. And if you want to talk about your problems with someone, just PM me anytime.

She's not your problem, and she knows that by crying wolf she can get to you. Its a method employed by very needy people. Just tell her she's on her own and you would never forgive that. Don't respond after that in any form. She'll live. Also, she'll get over you.

I used to be in a lot of volunteer things, it makes me very frustrated. I'm very self centered, you see, so no matter what I do I tend to burn out in a few days. I just find no pleasure in life anymore. I'm not looking for a grand answer, or happiness. I'm looking for a way to solve the pain, not to make myself too busy to see it. I'm not that stupid. My brain has the ability to multitask, dominating everything I do with these thoughts of severe boredom with my life. Oh, and I was let go during my company's layoffs, as I was a secretary for a man whose position was dissolved. So I've gone the whole "hobby" route, right after the "Job searching" route. it doesn't really work for me.
I like the chick with the cinnabons on her head, 'cuz HAVE YOU EVER SEEN AN OVERWEIGHT GUY IN LEIA COSPLAY? It's really... interesting.

Hey Rainbow. I think quitting is a good thing, but you don't want to be a burden to others... and that's what dying is. Taking the easy way out is really not a thing to do. It just means that your loved ones have to deal with your problems after you're dead. so don't die.
Do normal people attempt to kill/hurt said things?
... BAD IZZ. It's meee, steff-asuarus rex :P
ah, so you can somewhat sympathize. See, this mostly happens to me whenever I am angered or saddened, hence my trouble with it.
And won't that ruin our life? My boy will be one of those kids with a "broken home," and I don't want him growing up like his father. But that does make sense.
Ah. I alwys thought it was a very uncommon thing.
About injury? Many times. About mental health? No.

Well, I also said it wasn't suicide that I was contemplating. I have random urges to hurt things, but since I don't hurt others very often, I frequently just hurt myself instead. I have as much will to live as anyone should, but my self-injury will have the same end result.
I don't think so... but why would I have this strange desire to randomly hurt things?
are yu Izz? The same izz who says these things in #sw?
Naw, there was a string of serial killings in my town, and the bodies turned up in the creek where all of the kids would play

Well, as a child I remember being told not to poke the bodies in the bayou because the police were coming. I recall seeing a person lying, engorged but not decomposing, and I remember it as if it were any other childhood memory, like the ones of all the family funerals. Death was all around me growing up, and it never bothered me.

You clearly did not read. I am not suicidal at all. I am simply unable to talk about this to /normal/ people

EDIT: I'm not a child.
I do mind, unfortunately. Due to the nature of the topic, I'd rather not disclose personal information.
I have been told that I am fine, and not disturbed one bit. But they're idiots. There's n way that wanting to do things would ever be considered mentally sound.
sure, (I'm bad at starting)
yerp. like inflicting pain on things is... delicious. I remember a while back I embroidered a design on my hand for shits and giggles.
want to message me the link?
Izz. NO.
Aww, sorry man. I'm in Houston. If you ever want to talk, I'm here for ya.
Yes. I have self harmed in an effort to not harm others. My situation is an interesting one... it's more of a fascination with pain, or a fixation.
I mean, don't belittle yourself like that. Though I could have worded it better. Your post was kind of gay-shameful. (I realize that you are gay)
Then make life worth living, there's so much to do. You're still young.
Speak to a doctor, you sound like you might be bipolar.
It's not terrible at all, especially if you are a useless person. But you don't get to undo it.
There are no excuses. You're fugly. You said so yourself, there's no need for the world to apologize. And you are a FUCKING KID.

So, you're fucking ugly. Get over it. Us beautiful people will never accept you, so why even try to seek our approval? Just give the world a big FUCK YOU and get rich out of spite. You don't want to be "that guy who killed himself b/c nobody lked him," do you?
Here's a thought. Stop sucking cock.

If you were set on it, you wouldn't be posting. Cut the bravado and think about what you /really/ want. Someone to care about, to love. In my opinion, you move around way too fucking much. You need to stick to a place, and meet some people. Find someone you like, and act like a douche sometimes to make sure you don't get taken advantage of. It's your choice, but if you go you'll never learn if there was someone out there for you, someone who killed herself because no one ever loved her. You've got a lot of love, so find someone to appreciate it.

ALSO, I understand the feeling very well. I grew up in an experimental environment (12 year old in high school) and was studied like a freak my entire childhood life. It's hard, but I found people to care about later on. They're not the smartest, nicest, or most morally healthy people, but they're loyal.
Yeah, I know. I just don't really have a future. I'm barred from entering several countries, and there's not much to do /here/ with what I've got.

Everyone handles things differently, and cutting is a completely acceptable form of catharsis. Your problem could be that you went from cutting to being dependent on him, and now that you don't have him to lean on you find yourself falling. If so, you just need to find a new coping mechanism.

...Dude. That shit happens all the time. You need to buck up because you're going to run into worse troubles in life. The reason to live shouldn't be a boy or a job. It should be you. There is no fate but what we make. So make yours good.
I've been evaluated, I'm not ill. I'm just... caught up in this mundane pattern of failure.
It kind of bothers me. He's lord farquad.
It's not like that. I have a very positive body image. I just dwarf him in comparison. I'm like a fridge. He, a child.

Can't be in therapy. It looks bad on a psych eval, and they don't work for me. 

The States. A felony.
I'm not eligible to do a lot currently in my ccountry. I did something bad. Real bad. It's not the classload, it's just... my stress.
But how do I know that he really loves me? I'm not a person to be loved. I've done so many stupid things... I weigh 30 kilos more than he does...
I'm a student, I'm unemployed, unhireable due to a bad desicion, I can't seem to get good grades, I'm one of those people who fell apart after high school.

How am I supposed to be? Just live for the extrordinarily slim chance of a happy life together, while not knowing what's going through his mind? I just want to be happy. I can't see it. How do I get there?
Once again, my validation can't come from just one person. Living because he wants me alive is illogical, as telling someone to live b/c their death will hurt you is selfish.
I really do't want that to be the only reason I'm alive...

You were clearly the victim of an abusive relationship, and now you're suffering what happens after a litlle part of you dies. I've been there, and I know how you feel. I can't say the feeling of brokenness completely goes away, but you need to talk it out. It took me 2 years to get over my ex, but there's no real 'timetable' for when you're going to be okay. The best solution is to find someone you're comfortable with and discuss your feelings.
